name: branch-owners
description: Records which agent created each git branch and worktree, and lists the unmerged ones with their owners (/branch-owners).

baseBranch.title: Base branch
baseBranch.description: The branch that unmerged branches are measured against. Empty: origin/HEAD, then main. A value starting with - is refused.

exportPath.title: Export path
exportPath.description: Where `/branch-owners json` writes the table as JSON for a ledger script. Empty: no file. A leading ~/ is the home directory.
